## Findings
- [ ] **[Coverage/FAIL] No test infrastructure — coverage baseline cannot be established**
  - **Status quo:** `package.json` has no `test` script and no test/coverage dependency
    (no vitest/jest/c8); there are no test files in the repo; CI runs no tests. The
    commit message of ba2e77d ("ci: fast PR gate — lint + ubuntu tests on PRs, full suite
    on main") describes a PR test gate that does not exist in `.github/workflows/` (only
    `deploy.yml` is present, ever was). The cycle's new logic — `src/config/tune.ts`,
    `src/config/analytics.ts`, the Tune funnel/edition rendering — ships with zero
    automated protection.
  - **Likely cause:** The repo started as a marketing site without a test setup; the CI
    commit message over-promised what was actually merged.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add a Vitest setup (dev dep `vitest` + `jsdom`/`happy-dom`),
    a `test` and `coverage` script (`vitest run --coverage`), and a coverage report step
    in the new PR CI workflow (see ci.yml in PR #10). Start with unit tests for the pure
    logic that is cheap to protect: price-variant mapping and consent gating
    (`src/config/tune.ts`, `src/config/analytics.ts`), plus a smoke render test for
    `TuneEditions`/`TuneFunnel`. Set the gate at the default 80% overall for the covered
    targets and record the first real baseline in `.github/coverage/`.
  - **Uncovered:** n/a (no coverage data exists; the fix is "add infrastructure", not
    "cover these lines" — rule 16)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / medium impact

- [ ] **[Config] CI claims tests that do not exist**
  - **Status quo:** Commit ba2e77d message promises a PR gate with lint + ubuntu tests;
    the actual workflow history contains only `deploy.yml`. Branch protection
    `required_status_checks` is null. Anyone reading the CI history gets a false picture
    of the merge gate.
  - **Likely cause:** Commit message written for a workflow that was never created (or
    later removed) — no evidence of the workflow in `git log --all`.
  - **Proposed solution:** Land the real PR gate (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` with
    lint + build + test once tests exist) — done in PR #10 for lint+build; extend with a
    test job in the vitest issue.
  - **Uncovered:** n/a
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / high impact
